form.label: BigFix Inventory ETL Health & Performance
form.description: Monitors BFI task durations, parsing errors, capacity scans, and VM Manager synchronization.

search.query: index="bigfix" sourcetype="bigfix:bfi:import" "Success" ("ETL from" OR "Running ETL") | rex field=_raw "\(\+(?<duration>\d+:\d+:\d+\.\d+)\)\s+INFO:\s+(?:ETL from Data Source -|Running ETL|ETL from)\s+(?<task_name>.*?)(?:\s+\(|:\s+Success)" | eval task_name = trim(task_name) | search duration="*" task_name="*" | stats max(duration) AS "Max Duration (H:M:S)", latest(_time) AS "Latest Import" by task_name | fieldformat "Latest Import" = strftime('Latest Import', "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | rename task_name AS "ETL Task" | sort - "Max Duration (H:M:S)"

index="bigfix" sourcetype="bigfix:bfi:import" ERROR | rex field=_raw "ERROR:\s+(?<error_message>.*)" | eval error_message=coalesce(error_message, _raw) | stats count AS "Occurrences", latest(_time) AS "Latest Error" by error_message | fieldformat "Latest Error" = strftime('Latest Error', "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | rename error_message AS "Error Message" | sort - Occurrences

index="bigfix" sourcetype="bigfix:bfi:import" "CapacityScanImportStep" "capacity scan packages were downloaded" | rex field=_raw "(?<downloaded>\d+) capacity scan packages were downloaded" | rex field=_raw "(?<imported>\d+) files with capacity scan data were successfully imported" | rex field=_raw "(?<invalid>\d+) files had invalid names" | rex field=_raw "For (?<failed>\d+) scan packages or files the import failed" | stats latest(downloaded) AS "Packages Downloaded", latest(imported) AS "Successfully Imported", latest(invalid) AS "Invalid Names", latest(failed) AS "Failed Imports" by _time | fieldformat _time = strftime(_time, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | rename _time AS "Import Timestamp" | sort - "Import Timestamp"

index="bigfix" sourcetype="bigfix:bfi:import" "ILMTCoreVMMan::printStatistics" | rex field=_raw "(?<vmm_files>\d+) files from (?<vmm_count>\d+) VM Managers" | rex field=_raw "Processed clusters: (?<clusters>\d+)" | rex field=_raw "processed hosts: (?<hosts>\d+)" | rex field=_raw "processed guests: (?<guests>\d+)" | stats latest(vmm_count) AS "VM Managers Syncing", latest(vmm_files) AS "Files Processed", latest(clusters) AS "Clusters Found", latest(hosts) AS "Hosts Found", latest(guests) AS "Guests (VMs) Found" by _time | fieldformat _time = strftime(_time, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | rename _time AS "Import Timestamp" | sort - "Import Timestamp"
